opening: I've been hearing voices when there's no one there.
They started after my father died a week ago.
They talk about me in a negative way.
They urge me to harm myself.
I keep having unwanted thoughts that push their way into my mind.
I'm finding it hard to focus at work and in my studies.
My father died of lung cancer a week ago.
Losing my father has been very stressful for the whole family.

opening.text: I'm a student, and I've been feeling really anxious lately. My father passed away from lung cancer just a week ago, and losing him has been very stressful for the whole family. Ever since, I've been hearing voices when there's no one there; they talk about me in a negative way and urge me to harm myself. I also keep having unwanted thoughts that push their way into my mind, and I'm finding it hard to focus at work and in my studies.
